about.subtitle: Cellromax Science
about.description: Cellromax Science is a KOSDAQ-listed company founded with the mission of creating products that contribute to the health and well-being of people. Under the belief of making only the world's best products, we use only carefully selected quality ingredients through partnerships with globally recognized companies.

ceoGreeting.title: CEO Message
ceoGreeting.name: CEO
ceoGreeting.message: Cellromax Science will be the best partner for a healthy life.
ceoGreeting.paragraph1:
Having experienced both pharmacies and pharmaceutical companies,
I realized that the gap between pharmacists and consumers who want quality products
and suppliers trying to cut costs was far too wide.
I started Cellromax to bridge that gap.
ceoGreeting.paragraph2:
We only use the world's finest ingredients.
We only launch formulas that cannot be imitated.
As a result, we became a brand that grows without advertising,
a product that pharmacists seek out first.
ceoGreeting.paragraph3:
With our KOSDAQ listing as a springboard, we now advance into the global market.
A new standard of excellence in health functional foods —
Cellromax Science will lead the way.
